name: Sue (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Sue town emblem in white: a stylised four-pointed device with a disc, like a bird.
history: Municipal flag of Sue, a town in Fukuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 March 1973.

features.role: Sue town emblem — a stylised four-pointed device with a disc, like a bird
